text: Mostra l'identificador (`InvoiceId`) i el total (`Total`) de les factures (`Invoice`) el `Total` de les quals no coincideix amb la suma de `UnitPrice`*`Quantity` de les seves línies (`InvoiceLine`). Ordena per `InvoiceId`.
sql:
SELECT InvoiceId, Total
 FROM Invoice i
 WHERE Total != (
   SELECT SUM(UnitPrice*Quantity)
    FROM InvoiceLine il
    WHERE il.InvoiceId=i.InvoiceId
 )
 ORDER BY InvoiceId;

text: Mostra l'identificador (`InvoiceId`), el total facturat (`Total`) i el total calculat (`Total_Calculat`, suma de `UnitPrice`*`Quantity` de `InvoiceLine`) de les factures en què les dues xifres no coincideixen.
sql:
SELECT 
    i.InvoiceId,
    i.Total,
    SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) AS Total_Calculat
FROM 
    Invoice i
JOIN 
    InvoiceLine il ON i.InvoiceId = il.InvoiceId
GROUP BY 
    i.InvoiceId,
    i.Total
HAVING 
    i.Total != Total_Calculat

text: Mostra el tipus de document (`DocType`), el número de document (`DocNumber`), el nom (`FirstName`) i el cognom (`LastName`) dels hostes amb alguna de les 4 despeses totals més altes (`SUM(TotalPrice)`). Uneix `Hosts`, `StayHosts` i `Stays`.
sql:

FROM Hosts h JOIN StayHosts sh ON h.Id = sh.HostId 
JOIN Stays s ON sh.StayId = s.Id 
GROUP BY h.Id , h.DocType , h.DocNumber , h.FirstName , h.LastName
HAVING SUM(s.TotalPrice) IN (
	SELECT * FROM (SELECT DISTINCT  SUM(s.TotalPrice) 
		FROM Hosts h JOIN StayHosts sh ON h.Id = sh.HostId 
		JOIN Stays s ON sh.StayId = s.Id 
		GROUP BY h.Id 
		ORDER BY SUM(s.TotalPrice) DESC 
		LIMIT 4) AS t
	);
